faq_heading: New Westminster schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 24 schools with a New Westminster street address: 18 public schools and 6 independent schools. It also shows 4 college and university campuses. In that list, 5 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 3 alternate programs and 2 online schools.
Public schools here are run by School District 40 (New Westminster). Count by district: School District 40 (New Westminster): 18.

The list includes alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address, so the totals run higher than the number of neighbourhood schools; they sit under "other public schools and programs" below. The Ministry's own level field also mislabels some secondary schools as elementary, so this page reads the level from the school's name.

If you are buying with a child in mind, the address matters more than the list. A school's catchment decides which children it must take, and districts change catchments and set their own rules for French immersion and other programs. Ask the district about the exact address before you write an offer.

blocks.text: The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 105 licensed childcare facilities with a New Westminster address: 88 licensed group and 17 licensed family. The registry covers licensed care only. Care that does not need a licence is not listed by address, so a family may find more options than this count suggests. Names and addresses change often, so check the registry before you rely on any one facility.

faq.q: How many schools are in New Westminster, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 24 schools with a New Westminster street address: 18 public schools and 6 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers New Westminster?
faq.a: Public schools with a New Westminster address are run by School District 40 (New Westminster).

faq.q: How do I find which school a home is zoned for?
faq.a: Ask the school district to confirm the catchment school for the exact street address. Catchments change, and living near a school does not guarantee a place at it.
